newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian spycatcher makes offer agents can't refuse.
newsitem.headline: Russian spycatcher makes offer agents can't refuse.

text.p: The head of Russian intelligence has made a public appeal to Russians spying for foreign powers -- call our special hotline and become double agents.

In a sign the old KGB is adapting to the new market economy, the deal from Moscow's chief spycatcher is simple. Own up, and you can go on taking money from your foreign paymasters. Keep quiet, and we will get you in the end...

"We will find them all otherwise, sooner or later," General Nikolai Kovalyov, head of the Federal Security Service (FSB), the successor to the Soviet KGB, said in an interview on Moscow television channel MTK late on Tuesday.
The Moscow telephone number he gave -- 224-0035 -- was constantly busy on Wednesday morning. "That means a lot of people are calling," an FSB spokesman told Reuters.
